Page 1
Oct. Thanks - Joseph Noworsk - 33 - drinking fearfully. .. has been do- ing very much better ...
2 Aloysis Golob - 55 - has son-in-law quite indifferent to religion himself. Objects to having his children instructed ... she is anxious.
11 George P. Frank - 49 - promin police officer-(242 years on force - Major in band) Evidently honest, good fellow, in a general in- cightment with 65 others - accused of conspiricy in regard to gambling, etc .; has been attending holy Mass but away from sacra- ments 25 yrs. Now sees mistake, promises to go back to Confession and Communion ... Enrolled in Ser Mass Ass'n today
Emmet Sprague - 63 - Congrigation - serious domestic trouble .... Enrolled To-day
Mrs. Mary Osius - has two good rooms to let - at 712 University, Grosse P.
Pauline Darsten - 32 - threatening case of confinement - mother of Fam.
14 Lucia Rossi - 61 - liver - canser - Dr's have no hope for her re- covery. Enrolled To-day.
Page 2
Oct. 14 Frances Phillips - 5 - no apetite - enrolled To-day for year
14 Joseph Smith - 13 - Cleptomania - has been problem for parents, for schools, for court and police - peculiar seemingly bright boy - Enrolled in Ser Mass Assoc'n as annual before - Father promises to make him perpetual.
J. C. McGrath - 51 - Burgers diseas - colitis etc .- Mr. and Mrs. W.J. Mckenzie too - for guidance. Charles and Donalda Rogers Family - peace Bill Maher - on Destroyer U.S. Whipple 16 Thanks. Wm T, Butler - 63 - Railroad man for 24 yrs. Had narrow escape .... had "fits for 2 yrs .... Enrolled last August in Ser Masses ... No more fits. Deo Gr.
